summary.heading: Summary
summary.text: Systems architect with 11 years designing deterministic telemetry pipelines, multi-region storage engines and accessible operator consoles for energy and logistics platforms.
highlights: Cut regional failover recovery from 14 minutes to 22 seconds across 180 substations
Led migration of 42 internal operator consoles onto a single accessible token and component platform
Authored open specifications for low-overhead time-series compaction used by 14 engineering teams

experience.summary: Technical lead for grid telemetry ingestion and operator workflow consoles.
bullets: Re-architected the substation event ingestion pipeline in Rust and Go, sustaining 1.4M events/s at p99 latency under 18 ms.
Standardised 19 operator dashboard surfaces on an accessible design system with zero WCAG 2.2 AA contrast or keyboard defects.
Mentored 12 staff and senior engineers across storage, observability and frontend architecture guilds.

experience.summary: Owned control-plane reliability, schema registries and release automation.
bullets: Designed a deterministic schema-validation gateway that blocked 100% of breaking API deployments across 64 microservices.
Reduced control-plane memory footprint by 41% through zero-copy batch serialisation and compact ring buffers.
Built self-service fleet diagnostics tools that lowered mean time to resolution from 47 minutes to 9 minutes.
Implemented offline-resilient edge collectors for rail freight sensors operating over intermittent cellular links.
Built automated replay and audit tables for compliance reporting across 9,000 active sensor nodes.
